name: Almost Heaven Fairmont 4-Person Canopy Barrel Sauna, 6x5+2 ft. – 2 ft. Porch
description: Almost Heaven Fairmont 4-Person Canopy Barrel Sauna, 5x5+2 ft. – 2 ft. Porch With the Fairmont, there is no such thing as too functional. Measuring 5 by 7 feet, Almost Heaven allotted two feet of space for the exterior benches. This provides more space to cool off after the sauna or store water, towels, clothes, or even plants! The six feet of interior space is heated by a 6 kW electric heater of your choice. Properly installed, the Harvia KIP heater included in your sauna kit should consistently achieve temperatures of 180°F and beyond in 45-60 minutes, or you can delay the start time up to eight hours. Relaxation is only a few steps away with the Fairmont barrel sauna! If your sauna session is set to start later, you can delay the heating process by up to eight hours, ensuring the sauna is perfectly heated when you're ready. Whether indoors or outdoors, the Fairmont DIY barrel sauna is the perfect addition to make your house feel like a home. Want even more convenience and freedom? Opt for a WiFi-controlled heater to control and schedule your sauna heater from your phone, no matter where you are! Whichever you opt for, instant relaxation is just around the corner with the Almost Heaven Fairmont 4-Person Canopy Barrel Sauna! Features Ball-and-socket lumber: 1-3/8″ thick Any glass features are tempered Stainless steel bands, hinges, and fasteners Interior LED light Sauna stones included Weather-resistant plastic support cradles Two opposite-facing benches for sitting or reclining Indoor or outdoor usage Hand-crafted lumber profiles and end sections Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Best-in-class electric heater & sauna stones Made in the USA Specifications Holds up to four people Heater size: 6 kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hardwire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Assembled size: 72" x 82" Interior dimensions: 74.75" x 69.25" Bench dimensions: 18″W x 64″L x 17″H Weight: 800 lbs. Note: All dimensions are approximate Options and Customizations Vista or Port rear window: Open the Fairmont barrel sauna interior to breathtaking views with the addition of the Vista or Port rear window. Door style: Outfit your Fairmont 4-Person Barrel Sauna with one of the following deluxe door options: full glass door, wood door with a window, or all-wood door. Heater: You can upgrade the Fairmont barrel sauna from the standard Harvia KIP80B heater to a number of options. Scroll up to see all of them! Care and Maintenance Traditional barrel saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Shipping and Assembly The Fairmont sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. See the shipping tab for more details. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the manual’s assembly instructions in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Why Select Saunas? When it comes to customizing your sauna, we're the premier source for Almost Heaven Saunas. At Select Saunas, choose not only from our deluxe door and window options but also any heater or customization of your choice, and we'll accommodate you! Every sauna is backed by the original manufacturer's warranty, ensuring the highest standards of quality and performance. Plus, enjoy the benefits of free shipping, hassle-free returns, a no-questions-asked satisfaction guarantee, and complimentary gifts with your order!
